law: REGISTRATION of E-Q40 — THE LEXICAL-SENSITIVITY CENSUS (ORCH-R30 lane T21-a, the round's main event): the E-Q37 inverted decomposition (THE PHRASING LAW IS LEXICAL, NOT STRUCTURAL — question-side synonym swaps moved mass 16%/max 0.32 while reorder/reframe moved 2-3%) implies a per-word map on the STATE side: WHICH content words carry the noul mass? Design: the sealed E-Q21 20-record corpus; a principled sample of 6 content words per record (TF-IDF top-6, the salience rule frozen in situations/embedding_r30/eq40_build_wordmap.py and sealed in situations/embedding_r30/eq40_word_map.json BEFORE any spend); one single-word near-synonym substitution per call (all occurrences of the exact surface form, case-preserving, everything else byte-identical); movement measured against the sealed baselines and the 0.10 drift band. The census delivers the per-word sensitivity map, the distribution (do few words carry most of it?), the POS gradient (noun vs verb vs identifier), and the echo mechanism test (question-map lexical overlap).
agent: JEV research lane (R30 subagent), erised fleet line
provenance_of_the_question: The r28 close-out registration: 'the lexical-sensitivity census (which content words carry the mass — the T1 decomposition implies a per-word map)'. The r29+ plate carries it as the standing main event.

design_frozen.sample: 20 records x 6 words = 120 substitutions. Salience rule (mechanical, frozen): tokens [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(-[A-Za-z0-9]+)* lowercased, frozen stopword list, min length 3; score = tf_in_record * ln(20/df_across_records); top 6 per record by (score desc, first-occurrence asc, token asc). Sealed in eq40_word_map.json with the frozen substitution table (hand-crafted single-token near-synonyms, same word class; identifiers swap to sibling identifiers — any id swap changes the reference, that is the nature of identifiers, receipted; myriad = 10^4 exactly for the number word), POS classes (NOUN 82 / ADJ 16 / IDENT 11 / VERB 9 / NUM 1 / ADP 1), and mechanical echo flags (word-boundary {word, word+s, word-minus-s} match against the frozen E-Q25 12-question map text; 23 echo words, 97 non-echo; 1 substitute-side echo, N2 layer->tier vs P7, receipted).
design_frozen.calls: One batched 12-question call per (record, word): 120 substitution calls + 4 in-run anchors (N1/P1/Q1/A1, byte-identical states) + the flip-check canary (separate, the drift_monitor.py shape) = 125 typesafe calls, jev-latest, AS-SAID rows, resume law, model_served receipted per call (the Oct-21 flip law: any mid-run model_served change aborts the lane for re-registration).
design_frozen.measures: M1 per (record, word): per-record max |dp| over the 8 real axes vs the sealed r28 E-Q38 baseline (primary) and the sealed r24 E-Q22 vectors (secondary); per-axis movement distribution. M2 CONCENTRATION: breach rate (per-record max > 0.10) and the top-20%-of-words share of total movement mass. M3 ECHO CONTRAST: breach rates and medians, echo vs non-echo. M4 POS GRADIENT: median movement by class (NOUN vs VERB vs IDENT; ADJ/NUM/ADP reported outside the strict test). M5 AXIS TARGETING: among echo-word substitutions that breach, does the largest axis movement land on one of the word's echo axes? M6 the decoy floor under substitutions (480 readings). M7 shape preservation: Spearman(profile_subst, profile_base) per word.

floors.F1: the question map byte-identical to E-Q25/E-Q38 (sha asserted in code against the sealed tripwire rows)
floors.F2: each substituted state differs from the sealed record text ONLY at the sampled word's surface-form occurrences (boundary-consistent with the tokenizer; case-preserving; the runner re-derives and asserts the difference set)
floors.F3: one batched call per (record, word), all 12 answers present, p in [0,1], model_served receipted per call
floors.F4: the 4 in-run anchors must sit within the 0.10 band vs the sealed r28 vectors (a failed anchor fails the lane)
floors.F5: movement measured against the sealed r24/r28 vector files only (no re-derived baselines); the r28 E-Q38 baseline is primary
floors.F6: the word map (sample + substitutes + POS + echo flags) frozen at registration; no post-hoc edits; substitutions applied by explicit loop

hypotheses.H1_few_words: THE FEW-WORDS LAW: fewer than 30% of the 120 substitutions breach the 0.10 per-record band (a minority of words carry the sensitivity) AND the top 20% of words by movement carry at least 50% of total movement mass. LIVES iff both.
hypotheses.H2_echo: THE ECHO LAW: words that lexically echo the question map breach the band at >= 2x the rate of non-echo words AND at least 3 echo words breach (the vacuous 0-vs-0 case DIES). The mechanism: the readout is a lexical-overlap matcher — removing the state-side echo removes the bridge.
hypotheses.H3_pos_gradient: THE CATEGORY GRADIENT: median per-record max movement strictly ordered NOUN > VERB > IDENT (ADJ/NUM/ADP reported outside the strict ordering).
hypotheses.C38: THE LEXICAL CENSUS LAW: state-side noul mass is carried by a concentrated minority of question-echoing content words — LIVES iff H1 AND H2 (H3 reported as the gradient refinement; the claim does not ride on it, per-class n is small)

predictions.P1: the max single-word movement is >= 0.15 (one state word alone moves 1.5x the drift band — the T1 effect decomposes into single-word carriers)
predictions.P2: the most-moved axis (mean |dp| across all substitutions) is P8_exact or P6_null — the abstract axes, convergent with E-Q37 (most phrasing-susceptible) and E-Q38 (highest-drift)
predictions.P3: the decoy floor stays <= 0.05 under all substitutions (canary immunity extends to state-side word swaps)
predictions.P4: median shape Spearman >= 0.95 (single-word swaps preserve the profile shape even better than T1's 0.961 — one word is a smaller perturbation than three)
predictions.P5: the IDENT class has the lowest median movement of the three classes (identifier swaps are the floor of the gradient)
predictions.P6: among echo-word substitutions that breach the band, the largest axis movement lands on one of the word's echo axes for >= 60% of them (movement is axis-targeted, not diffuse)

falsifier: ANY of F1-F6 breached; the word map edited after registration; movement computed against re-derived baselines; the anchor band stretched; a mid-run model_served change unreceipted (aborts the lane).
budget: 125 typesafe calls (~$0.03 at the r28 per-call rate). Round ceiling $0.10 carried.
